p2_b5.ocr: A critical metric included in this table is the "Recorded" time, which is measured in seconds, indicating the duration of each recorded interaction or survey response. p2_b6.ocr: The survey posed a pivotal question regarding changes in portion size since moving to Canada, with answer possibilities ranging from "Eat much less" to "Eat much more," rated on a 5-point Likert scale. This structured inquiry not only facilitates a nuanced understanding of dietary shifts but also aids in identifying potential clinical signs associated with these changes. The results may offer valuable insights for nutritionists and health professionals addressing the dietary needs of newcomers.
